evidence_tier: executed differential (tier 1), against the OpenMS4 Linux x86_64 Release TOPP IDFileConverter; retained upstream TOPP output (tier 1) for TOPP_IDFileConverter_3; class-test literals (tier 3)
method: Lane F3a (wave 4) ported ProtXMLFile. The Release IDFileConverter of /ceph/ibmi/abi/oliver/opt/openms4-release-bc9cc12-c19e494-174b576 (sha256 3fc63d1d...) converted every input below to idXML with -test on ibminode06 (AMD EPYC 7763), twice, in a fresh HOME with a clean environment; both runs agreed byte for byte on the idXML, the stderr and the exit code (results/differ.txt empty). tests/protxml.rs reads each Release idXML back with this crate's idXML reader and compares it field by field with this port's load, and the tool's stderr line by line with this port's log; a failing conversion's exit code and message are compared too. The only modelled difference is PSI-MOD, which the crate does not bundle (docs/MODIFICATION_REGISTRY_SUPPORT.md): five named PSI-MOD candidates are removed from the Release ambiguity warnings (tests/protxml.rs, PSI_MOD_ONLY). IDFileConverter_3_input.protXML and IDFileConverter_3_output.idXML are the retained upstream TOPP test (test-data 0cb15f2, topp/), the ProtXMLFile_input_* files the class-test data, and the f3a_* inputs were generated by ../oracle/F3a-protxml/make_fixtures.py.
